questions: What is selection?
If the selection is harsh, do only the strongest make it through?
What is a bottleneck?
After a bottleneck clears, does everything return to its old mix?
What is the founder effect?
If the founder leaves, does the founder effect disappear?
What is an invasion?
If an invasion succeeds, does the invader take over everything?
What is a trait?
If a trait is useful, will everyone eventually have it?
What is fitness?
If fitness is high, does that mean it will live longer?
What is radiation?
Does radiation always make things sick?
What is a mutation?
If a mutation is fixed, can it still change later?
What is isolation?
If isolation ends, is everything connected again?
What is a hybrid?
Does a hybrid always get the best of both?
What is a mimic?
If a mimic is found out, does the mimicry stop working?
What is drift?
If drift gets stronger, does the population move faster?
What is a host?
If the host goes down, does everything on it go down too?
What is cooperation?
If cooperation pays off, does everyone keep cooperating?
What is a niche?
If a niche opens up, does the first thing to fill it get to keep it?
